prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me in your own words what happened at the intersection in Pearland?
A: I was going through a green light heading east. A pickup coming from the north side ran the red and hit the driver's side of my car. The impact was on my door and the rear quarter panel.
Q: Were you able to see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Not really. It came out of nowhere. I had maybe a second to react, and I tried to brake but there wasn't time.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: The side curtain did, I believe. The front ones did not.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?
A: My lower back is sore and stiff, especially when I sit for long periods or get up from the couch. I also have some tightness up between my shoulder blades.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or been to urgent care?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.
Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?
A: I started physical therapy about a week ago. I go twice a week, and I'm doing the exercises at home too.
Q: Did you have any back problems before this accident?
A: I had a little stiffness now and then from desk work, but nothing that stopped me from working or made me see a doctor.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send the physical therapy records when I get them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
